shortBulletSummary: US-Iran tensions persist and Strait of Hormuz is restricted, causing BTC price to fall.
Crucial US CPI data due August 12 is key for Fed interest rates and BTC market direction.
Bitcoin drops below $64K alongside spot ETF outflows and shifting institutional sentiment.
Altcoins face pressure as ETH and SOL correct with BTC while capital moves to mainstream assets.
CLARITY Act remains stalled in the Senate, causing regulatory uncertainty to persist.
